title: Prometeo · Growth Campaign
north_star: Scale useful multi-project product output geometrically while project Guides replenish frontier faster than workers consume it. Coordination is successful only when it becomes less visible.
truth_law: Do not call growth exponential from worker count, PIN count, commits or queue size. Growth is demonstrated only by durable productive units, project breadth, successor reproduction and visible/user-relevant progress while control-plane share remains bounded.

definitions.productive_unit: A durable RETURN/guide receipt that changes product/evidence/frontier or completes a real verification. Telemetry-only, NO_ACTION, stale-hint abort, pure boundary and transport failure do not count.
definitions.project_breadth: Unique product projects with at least one productive unit in the wave.
definitions.reproduction_ratio: Grounded claimable successor jobs created divided by productive units consumed in the same evaluation window.
definitions.visible_change: A material public/page revision represented by a new P### or equivalent page publication receipt.
definitions.infra_share: Productive units spent on Prometeo control-plane/infrastructure divided by all productive units.
definitions.frontier_reserve: Compatible product candidates remaining after the wave.

scale_policy.rule: Advance only when the current stage gate passes. On failure, do not ask the human what next: run one bounded systemic rescue against the dominant measured bottleneck, keep remaining capacity product-first, and rerun the same stage once.
scale_policy.steady_state: After MESH-06, choose batch size from real frontier capacity; default target is min(48, floor(product_frontier * 0.75)). Never increase beyond the previous stage unless the last two evaluated waves keep reproduction_ratio >= 1.2 and infra_share <= 0.15.
scale_policy.anti_starvation: Any active product project with zero productive units for two consecutive waves receives a coverage boost before global planner work.

stages.label: Chain proof
stages.purpose: Prove that one useful chat chains multiple productive units and that a wave advances several projects without draining the frontier.

stages.label: Scale 1.6×
stages.purpose: Scale throughput while preserving project breadth and successor generation.

stages.label: Compounding proof
stages.purpose: Require successor creation to outpace consumption while visible project results accumulate.

stages.label: Geometric scale
stages.purpose: Demonstrate that useful output and frontier reproduction keep scaling faster than coordination overhead.

stages.label: Adaptive steady state
stages.purpose: Keep product Guides and workers compounding without human routing.

rescue_policy.rule: Pick the single dominant measured systemic bottleneck. Do not spawn workers to repair individual wasted workers. Preserve product work in parallel.
rescue_policy.after_rescue: Re-run the failed stage once. If it fails again, freeze scaling and keep batch size constant until the measured bottleneck is closed.

campaign_steward.law: After each named wave, a Guide/Steward updates this campaign record by CAS with measured results and selects the already-declared next transition. The human should not need to ask 'what now?'.
campaign_steward.human_loop: launch current batch -> inspect GRW001 -> only intervene for taste/priority/authority

last_evaluation.note: Mesh admission and authority worked; project brains advanced across multiple projects. MESH-03 is armed to test multi-unit same-chat compounding.
